messages:
Ava (seceng): Quick sync — we want to enable a telemetry-forwarder sidecar in runtime pods to stream structured audit logs to our central sink. It needs to sign envelopes with the company keystore. Q: what's the recommended RBAC + KMS access pattern here? :lock:

Jon (eng-infra): @Ava long answer: do NOT give the sidecar direct access to raw key material. Use a signer-agent or KMS proxy and bind via Workload Identity / IRSA / IAM role. Short answer: service account -> IAM role with KMS:Sign -> no secret get of key material. :+1:

Ava (seceng): That sounds good. For Private deployments, some infra folks asked whether to bake the forwarder into the base image (so attestation covers it) or leave it as a sidecar. Security leaning toward baked image for attestation, ops prefers sidecar for fast patching. Thoughts?

Priya (runtime): Sidecar for normal tenants. Operationally it's easier to patch CVEs, and we can attest the sidecar image independently and reference the attestation in the deployment. If you bake, every app rebase is required. :eyes:

Jon (eng-infra): Agree with Priya. Also you asked RBAC — minimal Role example we used in staging (non-root container):

```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: telemetry-forwarder-role
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
- apiGroups: ["batch"]
  resources: ["jobs"]
  verbs: ["create"]
```

Jon (eng-infra): That lets the sidecar read a credential secret, but again do NOT store KMS unwrapping keys in a plaintext secret. Use a short-lived token (TokenRequest) combined with an IAM-bound service account or a KMS proxy that performs Sign/Encrypt on behalf of the pod.

Ava (seceng): Good call. Any changes needed to audit logging so we can detect misconfig or exfil attempts from the forwarder?

Ezra (oncall): Add structured fields to emitted logs: cluster, namespace, pod, service_account, forwarder_version. Add rate-based alerts: e.g., if forwarder traffic >100MB/min or >5x baseline for 3m, trigger paging. Also a missing-signature alert if envelopes arrive unsigned. :rotating_light:

Ava (seceng): For canary/rebuild window — we plan a base-image rebase next Tue. Should we include preflight checks in the rebase playbook to verify the presence of kms-proxy and signer-agent hooks?

Priya (runtime): Yes. Add a preflight step that verifies the following binary artifacts or sidecar image tags exist. We can add this to the rebase playbook YAML.

Ava (seceng): Example TokenRequest I used in staging for short-lived SA tokens:

```bash
# mint a 10m token for telemetry-sa in platform ns
kubectl create token telemetry-sa --duration=10m --namespace=platform
```

Jon (eng-infra): For cloud provider private deployments, prefer Workload Identity or K8s KMS provider to map SA -> cloud IAM role with kms:AsymmetricSign (or Sign). We'll add a snippet to the infra docs.

Ava (seceng): Can eng-security own a tiny rollout checklist? I want to coordinate with oncall and infra before the rebase. Plan: canary (5 pods) -> 30m soak -> roll to staging -> soak 2h -> prod smoke.

keystore-bot: Reminder: KMS key rotation scheduled 2024-11-07T03:00:00Z. Keys currently used by staging forwarders will be rotated; expect brief signer errors during rotation window.

Ava (seceng): Ack. We'll schedule canary before rotation and avoid pushing new key usage during the window.

Ezra (oncall): Ops detail: if forwarder can't reach KMS, fallback to encrypted local disk buffer (tmpfs) with TTL 24h. Ensure the buffer is encrypted with a local key wrapped by KMS so logs can't be leaked in plain text if pod escapes.

Ava (seceng): Action items I have: 1) eng-infra to publish SA->IAM mapping doc and token examples, 2) runtime to provide canary config + sidecar image attestation pointer, 3) eng-security to write rollout checklist and alert thresholds, 4) oncall to add rate/page rules. I'll collate and send a follow-up.

Priya (runtime): I'll post the canary manifest and image digest in this thread by EOD today.

Jon (eng-infra): I'll add the preflight check to the rebase playbook and the sample IAM policy.

Ava (seceng): Thanks everyone. Ping me if you need me to rearrange the rebase window. :phone:
